text_block_list.text:
The dream stage where humans enhanced by 
sasabari needles vie for supremacy on the 
race track―― The "Sasabari Twinkle 
Series."

The day of our first milestone toward 
reaching the top, the "Bamboo Stakes," had 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Beauty
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! <username>, heeeelp meeeee~~!!
choice_data_list:
...Are you Ms. Anshinzawa, by any chance? 
Or rather, definitely?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Without my charismatic Miracle 
Shining Glasses, my aura just fades right 
away~~~...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No way, I can't feel re~laxed without it! 
It's a matter of life and death for a 
genius acupuncturist and Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...And yet it blew away in the wind, got 
carried off in the bed of a truck, and in 
the end, a stray dog ran away with it—
choice_data_list: Does it feel like you've lost sight of it?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's right, yeahhhh~. Ugh, p-please save 
meee...

Fortunately, there is still plenty of time 
before the 'Bamboo Stakes'―― I decided to 
team up with Sasami Anshinzawa to search 
for her sunglasses.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Not here either...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here too...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Even here――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That dog under the overpass! That's 
the one!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Aha, cornered you at last! Give me back my 
sunglasses right now!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
This is a historic heirloom passed down 
through my family— Umm~... it's proof of 
my determination to give all Umamusume 
complete peace of mi~nd across every 
field!
choice_data_list:
There's an origin story behind those 
sunglasses...?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
A legend known as the Great Anshinzawa... 
yeah~, Anshinzawa... Yazaemon? Someone 
like that totally said so! Probably♪

text_block_list.name: Stray Dog
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrrrrrrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Pyaaah!?

The stray dog lunged, and in that split 
secondâ I seized the opening to snatch 
the sunglasses!

It seems that by now, even wild dogs pose 
no threat to me... Feeling a clear sense 
of growth, I handed the sunglasses over to 
Sasami Anshinzawa.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: *heart throb*...☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew, we made it just in time♪ Are you 
mentally prepared?
choice_data_list: The truth is, I'm really nervous……

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! That's when my bamboo 
needles shine! I'll strike the "secret 
acupressure point that turns you into a 
champion athlete" for ya☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy! It's my thanks to you for 
getting our family treasure back♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here we go, poke-a-roo!!
Bullseye needle poke, massive success!

The moment the pressure point was struck―― 
miraculously, all the anxiety vanished, 
and power came welling up in spades……!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It actually succeeded~! Guess there 
really is a point to trying after all♪

With high spirits, we were about to head 
straight toward the race, but――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait right there! I still have something 
to give you!

The moment the pressure point was struck―― 
for some reason, the anxiety surged even 
more, and I felt like I was being crushed 
by worry……!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh-oh~?? Is it not looking good? 
Seriously??
choice_data_list: I-I'll win through pure fighting spirit!

text_block_list.text:
Hoping to shake off that uneasy feeling, I 
headed toward the race, but――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait right there! I still have something 
to give you!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's "Miracle Shining Glass"♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
There, there, it suits you perfectly♪ As 
long as you wear this, you'll be totally 
saaafe!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so distant~! We've come all this 
way together, haven't we?♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm entrusting this to you precisely 
because it's you☆ ――Now go out there and 
win that race!

Power is surging endlessly from the 
sunglasses I inherited...!

Racing outfits are said to bring out the 
immense strength of the Umamusume wearing 
them, but—
choice_data_list: (In that case... this is my Racewear...!)
(In that case... this is my Racewear...!)

text_block_list.text:
To deliver victory to Sasami Anshinzawa 
watching from the stands, she sprinted 
through with all her might!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, <chrname>'s Trainer crosses the finish 
line in a glorious 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This year's Bamboo Stakes has been 
brilliantly claimed by the rising star who 
burst onto the scene like a comet!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This year's Bamboo Stakes has been 
brilliantly claimed by the rising star who 
burst onto the scene like a comet!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaahhh!! You did it, <username>!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's my partner for you♪ Let's keep this 
momentum going and rack up those wins~!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, gotta head to the 100-yen shop 
and buy the exact same pair of sunglasses 
again☆
